query: Can police arrest someone without a warrant?
relevant_cases: Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar
notes: CrPC S.41 defines warrantless arrest power; S.41A requires notice instead of arrest where not necessary

query: What is the punishment for murder in India?
notes: IPC S.302 prescribes death or life imprisonment for murder

query: How do I file an FIR at a police station?
relevant_cases: Lalita Kumari v. Government of Uttar Pradesh
notes: CrPC S.154 mandates FIR registration; Lalita Kumari held it is mandatory for cognizable offences

query: What is the law on dowry death?
notes: IPC S.304B defines dowry death; S.498A covers cruelty by husband or relatives

query: What are the guidelines to prevent misuse of Section 498A?
relevant_cases: Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar
notes: Arnesh Kumar guidelines restrict automatic arrests under 498A

query: What happens if police refuse to file my FIR?
relevant_cases: Lalita Kumari v. Government of Uttar Pradesh
notes: Registration is mandatory under S.154; Lalita Kumari established this as a legal obligation

query: What is the penalty for theft under Indian law?
notes: IPC S.378 defines theft; S.420 covers cheating (often charged alongside theft)

query: Is adultery still a crime in India?
relevant_cases: Joseph Shine v. Union of India
notes: Joseph Shine struck down Section 497 IPC — adultery is no longer criminal

query: What are my rights if I am arrested by the police?
relevant_cases: D.K. Basu v. State of West Bengal
notes: D.K. Basu laid down 11 guidelines for police during arrest; CrPC S.436 covers bail

query: When can bail be granted in non-bailable offences?
notes: S.436 covers bailable offences; S.437 covers non-bailable bail discretion

query: What is punishment for sexual assault or rape?
notes: IPC S.376 deals with punishment for rape

query: Is Section 377 still valid for same-sex relations?
relevant_cases: Navtej Singh Johar v. Union of India
notes: Navtej Singh Johar struck down S.377 for consensual same-sex conduct

query: What is the meaning of transfer of property in Indian law?
notes: TPA S.5 defines transfer of property as an act by a living person conveying property

query: What is the doctrine of lis pendens?
notes: TPA S.52 codifies lis pendens — property cannot be transferred during pending suit

query: What are my rights as a tenant and what notice period is required for termination of lease?
notes: TPA S.106 provides for 15 days notice for month-to-month leases

query: What is the legal definition of a contract in India?
notes: Contract Act S.2(h) defines contract; S.10 lists requirements for valid contracts

query: How do I get compensation for breach of contract?
notes: Contract Act S.73 provides for compensation for breach

query: Do real estate builders need to register their project under RERA?
notes: RERA S.3 mandates registration; S.18 provides remedies for delay

query: What remedy do I have if my builder delays possession of my flat?
notes: RERA S.18 allows return of amount with interest if promoter delays possession

query: What is the legal definition of sale of immovable property?
notes: TPA S.54 defines sale as transfer of ownership for a price

query: On what grounds can I get a divorce under Hindu law?
notes: HMA S.13 lists grounds for divorce including cruelty, desertion, conversion, etc.

query: Can I get maintenance from my husband during divorce proceedings?
relevant_cases: Rajnesh v. Neha
notes: HMA S.24 provides interim maintenance; CrPC S.125 provides maintenance to wife

query: What protection does the domestic violence law give me?
notes: DV Act S.3 defines domestic violence; S.12 allows application for protection order

query: Can people of different religions get married in India?
notes: SMA S.4 provides conditions for inter-religious marriages

query: How much maintenance can a wife claim under CrPC Section 125?
relevant_cases: Rajnesh v. Neha
notes: CrPC S.125 provides maintenance; Rajnesh v. Neha gave guidelines for quantum

query: What is the minimum age for marriage in India?
notes: HMA S.5 and SMA S.4 prescribe minimum age: 21 for groom, 18 for bride

query: What constitutes domestic violence under Indian law?
notes: DV Act S.3 defines physical, sexual, verbal, emotional, and economic abuse

query: What is the legal definition of a strike under labour law?
notes: ID Act S.2(k) defines strike as cessation of work by workers acting in combination

query: Can an employer terminate a worker without notice?
notes: ID Act S.25F requires notice and compensation before retrenchment

query: What is the law against sexual harassment in the workplace?
relevant_cases: Vishaka v. State of Rajasthan
notes: POSH S.4 mandates ICC; S.9 provides complaint procedure; Vishaka laid original guidelines

query: What are the principles for determining fair wages for workers?
relevant_cases: Workmen of Dimakuchi Tea Estate v. Dimakuchi Tea Estate
notes: Dimakuchi established principles for fair wage determination

query: How do I file a complaint about sexual harassment at work?
relevant_cases: Vishaka v. State of Rajasthan
notes: POSH S.9 prescribes written complaint within 3 months; Vishaka laid down the framework

query: Where do I file a consumer complaint in India?
notes: CPA S.34 District (up to 1 crore), S.35 State (1-10 crore), S.38 manner of filing

query: What is the definition of consumer under the Consumer Protection Act?
notes: CPA S.2(7) defines consumer as buyer of goods or hirer of services

query: Is medical negligence covered under consumer protection law?
relevant_cases: Indian Medical Association v. V.P. Shantha
notes: V.P. Shantha held medical services fall within the ambit of the Consumer Protection Act

query: What is the maximum compensation I can claim from a district consumer court?
notes: CPA S.34: District Commission has jurisdiction up to 1 crore rupees

query: What rights do consumers have against defective products?
relevant_cases: Indian Medical Association v. V.P. Shantha
notes: CPA defines consumer rights; V.P. Shantha established broad applicability

query: What does the right to equality mean under the Indian Constitution?
notes: Article 14 guarantees equality before law and equal protection of laws

query: What is the right to life and personal liberty?
relevant_cases: Maneka Gandhi v. Union of India
notes: Article 21 protects life and liberty; Maneka Gandhi expanded its scope

query: What is the scope of freedom of speech in India?
relevant_cases: Shreya Singhal v. Union of India
notes: Article 19(1)(a) guarantees speech; Shreya Singhal struck down S.66A IT Act for being overbroad

query: Is privacy a fundamental right in India?
relevant_cases: K.S. Puttaswamy v. Union of India
notes: Puttaswamy held right to privacy is a fundamental right under Article 21

query: How can I file a PIL in the Supreme Court?
notes: Article 32 provides the right to move the Supreme Court for enforcement of fundamental rights

query: How can I get information from the government under RTI?
notes: RTI S.4 mandates proactive disclosure; S.6 prescribes how to make an RTI request

query: Can the government restrict free speech online?
relevant_cases: Shreya Singhal v. Union of India
notes: Shreya Singhal held that Section 66A IT Act was unconstitutional for restricting online speech

query: What is the right to education in India?
notes: Article 21A provides for free and compulsory education for children aged 6-14

query: What is the meaning of copyright under Indian law?
notes: Copyright Act S.14 defines the exclusive rights that constitute copyright

query: What constitutes fair use or fair dealing under copyright law?
relevant_cases: Eastern Book Company v. D.B. Modak
notes: Copyright Act S.52 lists fair dealing exceptions; Eastern Book case addresses copyright in judgments

query: Can I be prosecuted for posting something offensive on social media?
relevant_cases: Shreya Singhal v. Union of India
notes: S.66A was struck down; IT Act S.79 intermediary liability was read down by Shreya Singhal

query: Are court judgments and orders protected by copyright?
relevant_cases: Eastern Book Company v. D.B. Modak
notes: Eastern Book Company held no copyright in court judgments themselves

query: What is the liability of internet intermediaries for user content?
relevant_cases: Shreya Singhal v. Union of India
notes: IT Act S.79 safe harbour read down by Shreya Singhal to require court order for takedown
